newsitem.title: EGYPT: Palestinian Airlines embarks on inaugural flight.
newsitem.headline: Palestinian Airlines embarks on inaugural flight.

text.p: Palestinian Airlines on Wednesday launched its first scheduled international flights when one of its Fokker planes with 48 passengers took off from el-Arish airport in Egypt for Amman, Jordan, airport sources said.

They said the airline would make twice-weekly trips to Jordan from el-Arish on Sundays and Wednesdays. The airline cannot fly from Palestinian-ruled Gaza until an airport is completed there and Israel gives approval for flights, but it has been operating charter flights from nearby El-Arish.
